headline: HOMEBODY learns to queue: taps stack, the list runs, chips show the plan
lede: The original's command layer is finally complete: click an object while a resident is mid-errand and the order joins their queue instead of vanishing — the list paints as little chips under the portrait, re-validates when its turn comes, and a chip tap calls it off. The attract bot never queues, so every old replay hashes byte-identical.

notes.text: Ownership law: orders the residents' own free will placed are preemptible by a tap exactly as before; only YOUR errands earn the queue — free will never outranks the hand on the screen.
Panel layout, hit-testing and the cancel route share one source (residentRows/QCELL), the pattern #2240 set — paint and tap can never drift apart.
Collapse or clocking in empties the list; a sold object drops honestly at issue time and the next item gets its turn.
New Node gate (homebodyqueuecheck, 40 pins incl. a seed-exact no-tap freeze computed against unmodified main); full drive 72/72, peoplecheck 585/585.
